factors.call: wk.lo_ret == 1 and green and body >= 0.3 * range and close > close[1]
factors.put: wk.hi_ret == 1 and red and -body >= 0.3 * range and close < close[1]

heads_up.call: wk.lo_lvl > 0 and wk.lo_run >= 1 and ((red and ((wk.lo_closes == 0 and wk.lo_dist <= 1) or wk.lo_closes >= 2)))
heads_up.put: wk.hi_lvl > 0 and wk.hi_run >= 1 and ((green and ((wk.hi_closes == 0 and wk.hi_dist <= 1) or wk.hi_closes >= 2)))

text.call: A hammer formed a weak low at {wk.lo_lvl} ({wk.lo_run} candles ago). Price is {wk.lo_dist} ATR over it (negative = below it) and has closed below it {wk.lo_closes} time(s) in a row. If the next candle turns green with a real body and closes higher than this one, the CALL signal follows.
text.put: A shooting star formed a weak high at {wk.hi_lvl} ({wk.hi_run} candles ago). Price is {wk.hi_dist} ATR under it (negative = above it) and has closed above it {wk.hi_closes} time(s) in a row. If the next candle turns red with a real body and closes lower than this one, the PUT signal follows.

heads_up.title: weak level ahead
